title: feat(app-shell): the sidebar trigger moves to the app bar's left slot at every width (objectui#12429)
body:
Fixes #12429
Clause-②: no

## What changed

- `packages/app-shell/src/layout/AppHeader.tsx`: the app bar's `LocalizedSidebarTrigger` is no longer `lg:hidden`. Inside an app it renders at every width as the left slot's first control, before the workspace switcher and the app pill (the slot the phone drawer button already used). Platform surfaces (Home, Workspaces, Studio front door) are unchanged: no sidebar, no trigger.
- `packages/app-shell/src/layout/UnifiedSidebar.tsx`: the `SidebarFooter` trigger is removed, and the footer with it (it held nothing else). The collapsed icon rail carries no trigger of its own.
- `packages/app-shell/src/layout/LocalizedSidebarTrigger.tsx`: the trigger reports `aria-expanded` for the state its click toggles (`openMobile` below the Shadcn mobile breakpoint, `open` above it) and carries a Radix tooltip naming the shortcut, spelled with the keyboard-shortcuts dialog's own keycaps (`shortcutKeycaps`, so it reads "⌘B" as the dialog does). The native `title` duplicate is dropped in favour of that tooltip. No new i18n string: the tooltip reuses `common.toggleSidebar`.
- No change to persistence (the `sidebar_state` cookie), the icon rail's contents, or the shortcut (Shadcn `SidebarProvider` listener, untouched).
- `.changeset/12429-sidebar-trigger-app-bar.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell` minor.

Clause-② measured: `LocalizedSidebarTrigger` is not exported from the package entry (`git grep LocalizedSidebarTrigger packages/app-shell/src/index.ts` is empty) and its props type is unchanged, so no published export widens.

## Mechanism finding (PM assumption A1)

`LocalizedSidebarTrigger` does not wrap the shadcn `SidebarTrigger`; it calls `useSidebar().toggleSidebar()` directly, which has the same effect. The breakpoint `toggleSidebar` uses is NOT `lg`: `useIsMobile` in `packages/components/src/hooks/use-mobile.tsx` reads `MOBILE_BREAKPOINT = 768` (md), and the desktop sidebar is `md:block`. So on `main` before this PR, between 768 and 1023 px BOTH triggers rendered (the app bar's, visible below lg, and the footer's), and both collapsed the desktop sidebar. After this PR one click in that gap collapses the sidebar to the icon rail, the same as at lg and above; below 768 px it opens the drawer. Exactly one trigger renders at every width. Pinned at 900 px.

## Tests

New pins:
- `packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/AppHeader.sidebarTrigger-12429.test.tsx` (real `AppHeader`, trigger as a recorder): exactly one trigger with no responsive `hidden` class; it is the left slot's first child, before the workspace switcher and the app pill; control: Home renders none.
- `packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/LocalizedSidebarTrigger.appBar-12429.test.tsx` (real `SidebarProvider` + real `UnifiedSidebar` + real trigger in a stand-in app bar): at 1280 px one trigger, in the app bar, no `data-sidebar="footer"`; one click flips the sidebar root's `data-state` to `collapsed` (icon rail, no trigger inside it), a second back to `expanded`, `aria-expanded` follows; the tooltip shows "Toggle sidebar" and "⌘B"; at 900 px one trigger and the click collapses; at 375 px one trigger before and after it opens the drawer, `aria-expanded` follows, the drawer carries no footer.

- `packages/app-shell/src/layout/` under the verify lock, pre-merge head `e763cb811`: `Test Files 69 passed (69)`, `Tests 483 passed (483)`, VERDICT command-exit 0.

Restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, `git diff HEAD` empty.

The config enables no type-aware linting, so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file. One error in the first draft of the new test (`object-ui/no-synthetic-event-trigger`, a dispatched `KeyboardEvent`) was fixed by dropping the shortcut half: the shortcut is unchanged and stays pinned by `KeyboardShortcutsDialog.wiredOnly-11674.test.tsx`.

## Acceptance notes

- Serial with PR #12443 (objectui#12427): it landed before this PR opened; `origin/main` `cf430cd10` is merged in (a merge commit, no rebase), and the merge into `UnifiedSidebar.tsx` was clean (Favorites block and footer are different regions).
- The design reference's x of about 12 to 36 px: the app bar's container pads `px-2 sm:px-4` (`packages/layout/src/AppShell.tsx`), so the 28 px trigger sits at about 16 to 44 px from `sm` up. Not measured in a browser.
- For a multi-membership user the trigger now precedes the workspace switcher inside an app (before this PR the phone button followed it). This keeps it the bar's leftmost control, as the card's acceptance asks.
